dct_description_sm: "Robinson, Bucrckhardt, Jacotin & c. ; London, Charles Knight & Co., 22 Ludgate Street ; W. Hughes, 1843."

"Robinson, Bucrckhardt, Jacotin & c. ; London, Charles Knight & Co., 22 Ludgate Street ; W. Hughes, 1843." Relief shown by contours and hachures. Shows Ottoman Empire administrative divisions, principal towns, roads, and caravan trails, Includes inset of "(Modern) Plan of Jerusalem". LC copy accompanied by cover page of: Maps of the Society for the Diffusion of Useful Knowledge / by the Rev. James Mickleburgh, A.M., London, Charles Knight, 22 Ludgate Street, 1847. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
